monitorability.approval_ref: WST-28: Kelly approval and policy review relayed by Elie on 2026-09-06

surfaces.note: Local source review surface; the server need not be running.
Separate noindex Pages monitoring candidate with synthetic sessionless signals excluded from production totals.
Existing GitHub Pages review surface; it is not counted as production.
Approved Cloudflare Pages production surface with sessionless aggregate homepage page-view and CTA instrumentation.

browser_traffic.source: WST browser beacon in approved sessionless aggregate mode
browser_traffic.next_action: Verify production receipts separately in WST and distinguish quiet traffic from collection failure.

edge_traffic.source: Cloudflare Pages and a declared Cloudflare Web Analytics configuration
edge_traffic.next_action: Verify read-only Cloudflare aggregate access and reconcile the declared analytics configuration with the absent live-page beacon.

cta.source: WST browser beacon with ten stable CTA identifiers
cta.next_action: Verify production CTA receipts separately in WST; treat presses as intent, not accepted inquiries.

conversions.next_action: Define an authoritative privacy-safe inquiry receipt; a mailto press alone is not a delivered or accepted inquiry.

health.next_action: Repeat safe GET checks after releases and retain version/content evidence separately.

field_vitals.next_action: Use privacy-safe field measurements when sufficient samples exist.

lab_performance.next_action: Run the shared responsive and performance matrix on the approved release candidate.

standards_evidence: The v249.1 release preserves Olea's verified services, inquiry flow, translations, policy routes, settings, theme controls, reduced-motion behavior, and fixed bottom-right version pill.
Ten stable CTA identifiers cover inquiry discovery, service navigation, email preparation, direct email, footer, and mobile actions without collecting form contents.
The build separates WST_PREVIEW synthetic/noindex behavior from explicitly approved WST_PRODUCTION sessionless aggregate collection, while the default build remains uninstrumented.
monitorability.standards_next_action: Complete the 320/375/390/768/1280, landscape, 200% zoom, keyboard, reduced-motion, fixed-control, and lab-performance acceptance matrix.
monitorability.disable_tracking: Build without WST_PRODUCTION=1 or WST_PREVIEW=1; the artifact then contains no WST beacon or monitoring disclosure, while all site interactions remain unchanged.

exceptions.reason: The repository and privacy policy declare Cloudflare Web Analytics, but the live homepage probe exposes no browser analytics beacon.
exceptions.next_action: Verify the Cloudflare analytics configuration read-only and record whether usable aggregate history exists.

exceptions.reason: Olea uses local mailto preparation, which proves only a button press and not email delivery, acceptance, qualification, or revenue.
exceptions.next_action: Choose a privacy-safe authoritative receipt source before reporting conversions.

exceptions.reason: Baseline responsive/accessibility controls exist, but the full shared acceptance receipt is not recorded.
exceptions.next_action: Run and record the shared responsive-performance matrix before claiming full standards alignment.
